role: Source-verified photographic pseudo-replication diagnostic, not independent biological sample
source_photo_disjoint_matching: Geometry/ID only; greedy maximal matching, not proven maximum cardinality
salient_non_support: At 10 disjoint pairs in the historically 30-edge eligible species, validation fixed_random__all_photos bootstrap CI includes zero, despite positive mean and p=0.025.
limitations: Photo endpoints cannot be shared in a selected matching, but observations need not be distinct genetic individuals, plants or field sites.
Post-outcome original-population restriction has its own retrospective status.
The fixed random matching is one reproducible geometry-only matching, not a distribution over every matching.
Permutation p values are not adjusted for multiple thresholds/schemes/policies.
No independent expert flower colour annotation or genotypic/fertility causal result exists.
